projects.title: 10x20 Hand-Soldered LED Matrix Arcade System (Space Invaders)
projects.tech: Arduino Nano, 74HC595 Shift Registers, Embedded C/C++, 200x 5mm LEDs, Piezo Buzzer
projects.summary: Custom-engineered a 200-node discrete 5mm LED matrix from scratch using cascaded shift registers and high-speed timer multiplexing.
projects.body:
1. HARDWARE ARCHITECTURE:
Instead of using pre-made addressable NeoPixel strips, I constructed a true row-column multiplexed grid by hand-soldering 200 individual 5mm LEDs (10 columns × 20 rows). Columns and rows are driven via cascaded 74HC595 Serial-In Parallel-Out (SIPO) shift registers interfaced to an Arduino Nano.

2. FIRMWARE & MULTIPLEXING LOGIC:
Implemented flicker-free persistence-of-vision (PoV) scanning by shifting bitframes at high refresh rates. Integrated tactile push-button interrupts for player movement/firing and programmed a piezo buzzer for retro sound effects.

3. KEY TAKEAWAYS:
Mastered current limiting, shift-registerdaisy-chaining, ghosting elimination during row switching, and ultra-compact C byte-array framebuffers.

projects.title: Synthesizable Digital ALU & Finite State Machine Blocks in Verilog
projects.tech: Verilog HDL, RTL Synthesis, FSM Design, Testbench Waveforms, GTKWave
projects.summary: Designed and verified modular RTL logic cores including arithmetic units, synchronous counters, and controller state machines.
projects.body:
1. RTL DESIGN:
Wrote clean, synthesizable Verilog HDL modules separating combinational data paths from sequential state registers. Avoided unintentional latch inference through complete case/default assignments.

2. TESTBENCH & TIMING VERIFICATION:
Developed self-checking testbenches to inject corner-case stimulus vectors. Inspected propagation delays, setup/hold windows, and state transitions using waveform viewers.

projects.title: Precision Analog Signal Conditioning & Active Filter Stage
projects.tech: Op-Amps, BJT Biasing, RC Active Filters, DSO Waveform Analysis, Voltage Regulation
projects.summary: Designed low-noise analog amplification and active filtering circuits for clean sensor-to-ADC interfacing.
projects.body:
1. CIRCUIT TOPOLOGY:
Engineered multi-stage operational amplifier filters to attenuate high-frequency switching noise prior to microcontroller ADC sampling.

2. LAB VERIFICATION:
Measured Bode frequency response, gain bandwidth product, and phase margin using a function generator and Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO).
